translated: When Ena was in elementary and middle school, summer break lasted until the 31st, so around this time, Ena was probably thinking...
"I can still make it! I don't have to start my homework yet!"
Yeah, on the 28th, you still feel like you're fine.
Exactly. It's not until the 30th that...
The real struggle is about to begin.
But some people have school today, so good luck to you all.
So for those who've already started, you've got the weekend to look forward to.
Good luck with your homework, everyone.
Wait, were you the type to finish it early, Shizuku?
Ena would put it off until the very last second, thinking she was fine, and then end up suffering for it.
Every year on the 31st, Shizuku would be crying while watching that 24-hour charity telethon...
...and working on her independent research project.
They always say you should be more organized with those projects, but...
There's a certain charm to finishing it at the last minute.
